title: Difficulties of house move
objectives: describe challenges during a home move
use adjectives like heavy, difficult, busy

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Difficulties of house move.
Welcome to today's lesson: Difficulties of house move! Today we will practice how to describe challenges during a home move.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Difficulties of house move:
describe challenges during a home move; use adjectives like heavy, difficult, busy

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: heavy, difficult, move, pack, clean, busy

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Why is moving house described as challenging?

options: The wardrobe is heavy and there are boxes to pack.
answers: The wardrobe is heavy and there are boxes to pack.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Moving today is very busy. We have heavy boxes to pack and clean.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Moving house is difficult and busy. The wardrobe is heavy. We pack boxes and clean the flat.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Discuss what makes moving house difficult and how to organize packing.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: describe challenges during a home move, use adjectives like heavy, difficult, busy.
